_comment: How Tools/Blender/build_ai_ship.py turns the Higgsfield multi-image GLB (Higgsfield/Wayfarer_multiview_v1.glb, from the approved concepts side_a / threequarter / top_v2a / front) into Wayfarer_AI.blend. Coordinates are Blender metres after orienting and scaling: +X nose, +Y port, +Z up. Model to layout: x_layout = x + 10.25, z_layout = z + 1.03 (layout: hull aft end x 0, deck floor z 0). Measured on the oriented model (24. 9. 2026): 21.5 x 13.65 x 5.45 m; fuselage z -1.63 .. 1.92 (3.55 m, as drawn), 3.8-4.0 m wide ahead of the wings; engine pods merged close to the fuselage (centres y +-2.46 instead of the drawing's 3.4) with nozzles at x -10.75 .. -9.9, a cluster of small nozzles between them at x -9.1; wings droop towards the tips; gear fused into the belly: nose leg x 4.8 .. 6.3 on the centreline, main legs x -5.8 .. -4.5 at y +-1.4 .. 1.9, pads at z -2.7; the rear ramp hangs half open to z -2.57. Silhouette against the drawing (silhouette_compare.py, bbox): side 0.91, top 0.78, front 0.59.

orient._comment: The GLB has the nose along -X.

Gear._comment: Everything below the belly at the three legs; the stubs above the cut stay on the hull as mounts. fill_holes off: on this mesh the filler bridged the open wing and pod boundaries with huge flat faces.

Ramp._comment: The rear ramp hangs half open under the aft belly in the AI model (x -9.9 .. -7.8, down to z -2.57). Its own part keeps the hull's belly clean above the gear (landing test) and is the piece the game can later swing open and shut.

collision.name: gear main legs down to the pads
gear nose leg down to the pad

Cockpit._comment: Provisional pilot eye above the seat of the drawing (layout x 16.9, z 1.78 = seat floor 0.35 + 1.43); refined with the interior (step 4).

Exit._comment: Behind the rear ramp on the ground, clear of the collision.

emissive._comment: The whole nozzle disc of each pod glows evenly (normal_x_max -0.1): with only the faces pointing straight back it glowed as a patterned medallion (author, 24. 9. 2026).

repaint._comment: Tools/Blender/repaint_ship.py after every build: the AI colours only decide which paint zone a face belongs to; each zone gets one clean colour. Colours are sRGB (texture values): warm off-white and gunmetal of the approved style A, Halcyon orange.
